recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. If diagram regeneration is later in scope, regenerate MessageHeader diagrams from the current StructureDefinition rather than manually editing the SVG; no normative or conformance source change is needed for FHIR-41269.
issue_request: FHIR-41269 was an Applied/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-core MessageHeader change request for R6 asking whether MessageHeader.sender, MessageHeader.author, and MessageHeader.responsible should be removed. The final resolution was to move sender under source as the last element and remove author and responsible.
initial_application: Commit 21db7ce85648ecbcc2a88295b74e4a4015053b22 applied the change by removing the top-level MessageHeader.sender, MessageHeader.author, and MessageHeader.responsible differential elements and adding MessageHeader.source.sender. A later spelling/usage commit 871a89035ebfc9af87f56b538de42cdbdf5f58c0 changed the retained sender definition from sending system to sending entity.
additional_context: INM minutes for 2023-09-13 record the 10-0-4 motion to move sender under source and remove author/responsible, applying it to FHIR-41269 and related MessageHeader issues. FHIR-41271 clarified that MessageHeader is needed to interpret a message bundle but should not remain relevant once message contents are moved elsewhere. The current source/fhir.ini actively includes MessageHeader and carries legacy conversion mappings from MessageHeader.sender to MessageHeader.source.sender while dropping author and responsible.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The authoritative current MessageHeader StructureDefinition defines MessageHeader.source.sender and no top-level MessageHeader.sender, MessageHeader.author, or MessageHeader.responsible elements. The sender search parameter points to MessageHeader.source.sender. A repository search found only compatibility mappings in source/fhir.ini and stale generated-looking references in source/messageheader/messageheader.svg for the old top-level elements; the run guardrail says not to make a source-changing commit when only a checked-in SVG/diagram appears stale and the authoritative source is correct.

related_jiras.note: The author/responsible distinction question was resolved by the same 2023-09-13 motion to remove those elements.
The author typo issue became no-change because MessageHeader.author was removed.
The sender definition issue was handled by moving sender under source and later changing the definition to say sending entity.
The Da Vinci Alerts question and Zulip thread supplied implementer context for reconsidering sender, author, and responsible.
The messaging-context clarification removed the blocker for deciding which MessageHeader metadata should remain.
